parts:
Figure it out

A: Are you warm enough?

B: No, I’m not. I’m too cold. Please close the window.

Grammar | too and enough

We use too and enough with adjectives to describe the amount of something.

• too + adjective means that 1 .

This tea is too hot! I can’t drink it.

• adjective + enough means that 2 .

I’m old enough to take my driving test.

• not + adjective + enough means that 3 .

You aren’t fast enough to catch the bus!
